title: Rebooking Relief after a Missed Personal Services Plan Visit
content:
A Personal Services Plan resident who books the same service again soon after a late-cancelled or missed visit owes fewer hours for the missed visit.

## Rule

The rebooking multiplier is read from the most recent booking of the same service on the plan: 0.25 where that booking was made no fewer than 0 and no more than 2 days after the missed visit date, 0.6 where it was made more than 2 and no more than 7 days after it, and 1 otherwise. The hours owed for the missed visit are multiplied by the rebooking multiplier before they are rounded to two decimal places half up.

The most recent booking is the one with the latest booking moment among the plan's orders for the same service as the missed order; the days are calendar days from the missed visit date to the date of that booking moment.

## Ladder

| Most recent booking of the same service made | Rebooking multiplier |
|---|---|
| 0 to 2 days after the missed visit date | 0.25 |
| More than 2, up to 7 days after it | 0.6 |
| Before the missed visit date, or more than 7 days after it | 1 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical missed visit on 10 June)

| Latest booking of the same service made on | Days after the visit date | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 9 June | Before the visit date | 1 |
| 10 June | 0 | 0.25 |
| 12 June | 2 | 0.25 |
| 13 June | 3 | 0.6 |
| 17 June | 7 | 0.6 |
| 18 June | 8 | 1 |

*Hypothetical:* a missed companion visit owing 1.0 hour before the rebooking multiplier, followed by a new companion visit booked 5 days later, owes 1.0 multiplied by 0.6, or 0.60 hour.
